description:
Approved page /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.8.html (2026-11-08), following Elixir's own path (../elixir: IO.write is the one write over :io.put_chars; IO.puts = write + newline; IO.inspect = puts(inspect(item)) returning item; Kernel.dbg is library code over inspect and IO.write). fz mirrors it piece for piece: StdoutOutput::emit writes bytes and stops appending a newline; one extern fz_io_write(binary) hands bytes to the output hook (write_output replaces emit_print_line); lib/io.fz defines write/1, puts/1, inspect/1 with Elixir's bodies over String.Chars (a list argument raises ArgumentError until chardata is built; a map or tuple is refused at compile time naming String.Chars); Kernel.dbg(x) becomes IO.inspect(x), deleting fz_dbg_value and fz_dbg_value_ref. dbg prints what our IO.inspect prints; any difference from Elixir's text is a renderer fix in fz-sc8.10, never an adapter. DbgCapture splits bytes on newline; drive_test's fz_dbg_value-keyed tests and fixture 00606 move to send/fz_send; fz-sc8.55 folds in as the top-level IO.puts fixture (00783). No longer depends on fz-sc8.10.

Decisions taken 2026-11-08 after the first build (WIP commit 79d97ed97 on fz-sc8.8/io):
- fz_io_write is declared `:: unit`, not `:: :ok`: an atom return lands on the any lane and boxes 16 bytes per print, which moved every heap golden; the wrappers answer :ok themselves, as every helper returns a machine value and its wrapper builds the fz value.
- String.Chars.Binary.to_string's error branch builds its message with `<>` over Kernel.inspect(s) instead of interpolation: interpolation calls to_string on that binary and dispatches back to the same impl, a runtime-unreachable direct cycle that the reach pin on closure_threaded_recursion (0 direct cycles) would otherwise count.
- The renamed float twin of compiler2_extern_send_return_is_its_contract_applied_to_the_row is deleted; 00606 already pins int and float rows.
- Census pins rise by one measured mechanism, the dbg cone (IO.inspect, puts, to_chardata, Kernel.to_string, <>, Binary.to_string, raise branch): 10 lib pins, 3 fz2_cli pins, 7 heap-stat goldens. Authorized once re-measured after the `<>` change.
- Blocked by fz-sc8.97 (root return of a six-lane tuple), which fixtures2/behavior/anonymous_fn_bare_params hits once dbg returns through typed code. fz-sc8.98 (JIT skips resource destructors after enough allocation) is latent and not blocking.
title: IO.puts/1 writes a string to stdout
